fact: NITA-U launched the U-Learn Platform, developed with the Ministry of Education and Sports, on which over 6,600 teachers from 26 Teacher Training Institutions have enrolled and over 380 users have earned verified digital certificates, as one of 14 e-services being rolled out under UDAP-GovNet.
The Daily Monitor reports Uganda has sector-specific e-services in revenue, company registration and procurement.
